task: Audit emitter expression parser counters during retained-tree migration.
observation: Two emitter parse paths were outside the existing reparsing counter: borrowed-view index inspection called parse_view directly, and named-argument projection called parse_named_argument_view directly. Routing the first through expression_view_from_est and counting the second increases accounting visibility without changing generated Rust.
impact: Prior paired consumer counts undercounted these parse sites, so historical sample deltas are not strictly comparable without matching instrumentation on the phase27-5-3-c1 baseline.
evidence: examples/collections_and_methods.moss: candidate 1,244 text lookups / 532 expression-view reparses; generated Rust identical to c96 parent

resolution.summary: Instrument the same sites in the pinned parent build before reporting a strict paired delta.

task: Lower a pipeline represented by retained EST nodes without parsing its source text.
observation: Bootstrap and source inspection found no optimizer parser entry point. In the emitter, functional_pipeline() intentionally recognizes only built-in operations, while the checker records user-named pipeline stages as ordinary call edges. Reading the retained Pipeline/Call nodes plus those checked edges allowed direct nested-call lowering without a functional plan.
impact: For mini_application.moss, native functional-pipeline reparses fell from 2 to 0 and total expression reparses fell from 6,122 to 2,018 against the counter-matched parent, with byte-identical Rust and runtime output.

resolution.summary: The checked callable-pipeline node path handles the pure local fixture shape. Other pipeline node shapes still need coverage and lowering.

task: Remove emitter parsing for checked identifier nodes.
observation: View projection already resolves representation-sensitive names; after it declines, ordinary locals and non-view domain state/route identifiers can be lowered from their retained Identifier node. The mini-application node fallback count became zero with byte-identical Rust.
impact: On the paired mini-application workload, lookups fell 9,497 -> 3,031 and expression reparses 6,122 -> 1,610 per default or optimized command. A separate member-call experiment introduced a clone and was reverted, confirming that some legacy expression paths still encode ownership decisions.

resolution.summary: Retain the identifier lowering; keep the ownership-sensitive member-call route unchanged.

task: Use checked call-edge targets for retained member-call nodes.
observation: A unique checked call edge can fill a missing member-call node target. The ordinary value-context index lowering clones indexed values, so the narrowly supported Vector/Seq method receiver path preserves method-place rendering to retain existing Rust autoref behavior.
impact: For collections_and_methods.moss, generated Rust stayed byte-identical in default and -O, while paired lookups/reparses fell 2,607/1,259 -> 855/194. The Rust compiled and execution output matched.

resolution.summary: Keep the checked target path for the tested Vector/Seq indexed method-receiver shape; other ownership-sensitive receivers remain uncovered.

task: Keep callback expression nodes alive when converting a functional pipeline through the emitter compatibility parser.
observation: ASan traced a stack-use-after-return in generated callable result handling to ParsedFunctionalPipeline retaining pointers into a local temporary EST arena. Moving arena ownership into the parsed pipeline and rebinding stage arena pointers removed the dangling lifetime.
impact: The map-call argument source emits and compiles again and prints 4 in default and optimized modes. Fast Debug still fails on the same source on both C1 and candidate due to its existing missing checked-node invariant.

resolution.summary: Parsed compatibility pipelines retain shared ownership of their temporary arena; Fast Debug failure is baseline debt outside this emitter change.
